meta.title: Per-province household debt (all households) — NSO SES 2566, AUTHORITATIVE
meta.label: MEASURED — average household debt (THB) per canonical Thai province, all households, from the National Statistical Office Socio-Economic Survey (SES) 2566 (2023 CE), pulled from NSO's own open-data catalog and reconstructed to the province level by household-weighted mean over the survey's socioeconomic strata.
meta.source: NSO (สำนักงานสถิติแห่งชาติ), กองสถิติสังคม — CKAN package 0705_08_0009, resource SFD_SPB0806 (89cc71ae-f596-4307-b38f-10d61d084801).
meta.basis: ALL households (table SFD_SPB0806 'ครัวเรือนทั้งสิ้น'), NOT the indebted-only subset (SFD_SPB0807).
meta.method: Province average = household-weighted mean of each socioeconomic leaf group's (soc_eco_class1 x soc_eco_class2) average debt-per-household, weighted by that leaf's total-household count. The table carries no pre-aggregated 'all households' row, so the province total is reconstructed from the strata.
meta.national_check: Equals NSO's published SES 2566 national headline (197255 THB) — the reconstruction's built-in correctness proof.
meta.gate: network puller, NOT in the determinism gate (live off-repo input, like ingest_tmli.py). Everything downstream of this committed file IS gated: build_household_risk.py --check.
